title: Bo-Katan Kryze
subtitle: Reclaiming Mandalore
text: Action [2 resources, Exhaust]: If you control a unit in each arena, create a Mandalorian token.
deployBox:
Other friendly Mandalorian units get +1/+0.
On Attack: If you control a unit in each arena, create a Mandalorian token.
epicAction: Epic Action: If the number of resources you control plus the number of friendly Mandalorian units is 10 or more, deploy this leader.
rules: Bo-Katan’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if you don't control a unit in each arena (but you don't create a token).
